notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional nontoken non-Human creature with toughness two or greater.
description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Ayara, targeting any other nontoken non-Human creature you control.
Ayara dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Ayara enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability from step 1, putting a -1/-1 counter on the additional creature and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the additional creature, targeting Ayara.
The creature dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
If the creature was black, it enters the battlefield, triggering Ayara, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Ayara and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
